# Transportation

# Transportation  
There are many ways to get around Pittsburgh... car, bus, taxi, bike, pedicab, boat or your own two feet!  
We have the tips and information you need to get around town. Pittsburgh is featured on Google Transit. This partnership with the Pittsburgh Regional Transit allows visitors to search for public transportation routes using interactive Google Maps technology. Pittsburgh Regional Transit is the public transit agency for the Greater Pittsburgh area, providing bus, light rail, incline and paratransit service to thousands of riders daily.  
Flying? You're going to love Pittsburgh International Airport. PIT, in airport parlance, is a growing world-class facility that serves more than 8 million passengers annually and offers flights to more than 50 nonstop destinations on multiple carriers.

# Transportation
## Where is Pittsburgh?

## Where is Pittsburgh?  
Pittsburgh is located in Southwestern Pennsylvania, where the the Ohio, Allegheny, and Monongahela Rivers meet. Pittsburgh is about 45 miles east from the Ohio border and about 300 miles west of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.  
Use the map below to route out your trip, plan your must-see stops and navigate our city like a pro!

# Transportation
## Travel Advice

## Travel Advice  
Stay up-to-date with current travel information on VisitPITTSBURGH.com or call (412) 281-7711, Toll Free (877) 568-3744. If you’ve just arrived at Pittsburgh International Airport, stop by our Welcome Center at the Baggage Claim area.  
In town for a meeting or event? Our Welcome Center inside the David L. Lawrence Convention Center is also open on select dates for conference attendees. We can’t wait to welcome you to Pittsburgh soon!
